snippet.title: Space Scum - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Space Scum, a turn-based strategy tactical RPG developed by Sole Survivor Games. 

Players will take charge of a band of mercenaries to travel across planets, acquire loot, and engage in deep turn-based combat for survival. Space Scum is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#SpaceScum #TacticalRPG
